summary: 18 features and 1 fix across HagiCode-org/hagicode-core, HagiCode-org/web.
bodyHtml:
Features

HagiCode-org/hagicode-core

  • doubao: enhance WebSocket handler with monitoring and hotword support (826c022)
  • doubao: add DoubaoVoice runtime config resolver (ca73d9d)
  • frontend: enhance frontend config store (3f2d2d0)
  • sessions: add auto-task execution to sessions (316a628)
  • git: enhance ProjectGit watcher registry (767bd72)
  • orleans: add proposal description grain (8e16e5a)
  • claude: add Codex retry and cleanup coordinators (7cbc4fc)
  • domain: add configurable Co-Authored-By modes (9671f1d)
  • hero: add custom avatar storage and assets API (84813d1)

HagiCode-org/web

  • hero: add HeroAvatarThumbnailTile component and improve avatar components (36e5b63)
  • settings: improve error retry settings and provider error panel (18babb8)
  • realtime: improve session realtime updates and SignalR handling (4f534a8)
  • vault: add auto-compose commit drawer and improve vault UI (05c9bdf)
  • i18n: add translations for hero custom avatar and settings (0a2e5d6)
  • settings: add brand customization and improve settings tabs (a6819eb)
  • git: enhance auto-compose and git tab components (1506fbc)
  • hero: add custom avatar support and improve hero components (6544f5e)
  • hero: add custom avatar upload service (1c88285)

Fixes

HagiCode-org/web

  • reports: improve HagiPower directional chart card (7f91124)
